<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
  
  <!-- Top status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="24" y="28" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="314" y="17" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#222741"/>
      <rect x="320" y="14" width="4" height="13" rx="1" fill="#222741"/>
      <rect x="326" y="11" width="4" height="16" rx="1" fill="#222741"/>
      <rect x="332" y="8" width="4" height="19" rx="1" fill="#222741"/>
      <circle cx="349" cy="16" r="2.3" fill="none" stroke="#222741" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="342" y1="14" x2="346" y2="18" stroke="#222741" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="345" y1="11" x2="350" y2="16" stroke="#222741" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <rect x="357" y="11" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#222741" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <rect x="379" y="15" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#222741"/>
      <rect x="359" y="13" width="16" height="8" rx="2" fill="#222741"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Hero blue section -->
  <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="360" fill="#3F63F6"/>
  <rect x="0" y="404" width="390" height="440" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
  
  <!-- Decorative circles and blobs -->
  <circle cx="304" cy="134" r="78" fill="#B2C6FE" opacity="0.22"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="146" r="52" fill="#1F36B1" opacity="0.14"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="290" r="30" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="330" r="22" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.10"/>
  
  <!-- Wallet illustration -->
  <g>
    <rect x="57" y="84" width="276" height="250" rx="28" fill="#B2C6FE" opacity="0.28"/>
    <rect x="74" y="102" width="242" height="214" rx="28" fill="#14248E" opacity="0.20"/>
    <rect x="92" y="116" width="206" height="186" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="106" y="128" width="178" height="160" rx="20" fill="#3F63F6"/>
    <rect x="106" y="128" width="178" height="34" rx="20" fill="#1F36B1"/>
    <circle cx="140" cy="180" r="18" fill="#99E86C"/>
    <circle cx="154" cy="170" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="172" y="168" width="88" height="12" rx="6" fill="#B2C6FE"/>
    <rect x="172" y="190" width="72" height="10" rx="5" fill="#B2C6FE" opacity="0.9"/>
    <rect x="126" y="226" width="136" height="22" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="126" y="256" width="96" height="10" rx="5" fill="#B2C6FE" opacity="0.75"/>
    <rect x="126" y="272" width="64" height="10" rx="5" fill="#B2C6FE" opacity="0.55"/>
    <polygon points="276,236 289,236 282.5,224" fill="#99E86C"/>
    <rect x="274" y="226" width="16" height="12" rx="3" fill="#99E86C"/>
    <rect x="250" y="268" width="24" height="14" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.20"/>
    <rect x="116" y="150" width="60" height="86" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="180" y="150" width="50" height="86" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Illustration shadow -->
  <rect x="80" y="294" width="230" height="20" rx="10" fill="#14248E" opacity="0.18"/>
  
  <!-- Onboarding title and copy -->
  <text x="24" y="446" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Dompet digital</text>
  <text x="24" y="476" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">yang simpel, aman,</text>
  <text x="24" y="506" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">dan siap dipakai setiap hari</text>
  
  <text x="24" y="542" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#B2C6FE">Bayar tagihan, kirim uang, dan kelola saldo</text>
  <text x="24" y="564" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#B2C6FE">dalam satu aplikasi yang mudah digunakan.</text>
  
  <!-- Step progress indicator -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="592" width="342" height="8" rx="72" fill="#DCDDDF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="592" width="112" height="8" rx="72" fill="#99E86C"/>
    <rect x="144" y="592" width="100" height="8" rx="72" fill="#DCDDDF"/>
    <rect x="252" y="592" width="114" height="8" rx="72" fill="#DCDDDF"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Feature cards -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="618" width="342" height="70" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="26" y="620" width="342" height="70" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="653" r="16" fill="#B2C6FE"/>
    <text x="48" y="659" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1F36B1">₫</text>
    <text x="82" y="645" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#222741">Top up instan</text>
    <text x="82" y="663" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#75788D">Isi saldo dalam hitungan detik</text>
    <rect x="286" y="640" width="62" height="24" rx="12" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
    <text x="301" y="656" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#3F63F6">Baru</text>
  </g>
  
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="698" width="342" height="70" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="26" y="700" width="342" height="70" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="733" r="16" fill="#99E86C"/>
    <polyline points="46,733 52,739 62,726" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="82" y="725" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#222741">Transfer cepat</text>
    <text x="82" y="743" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#75788D">Kirim ke sesama pengguna dan bank</text>
    <rect x="274" y="720" width="74" height="24" rx="12" fill="#B2C6FE" opacity="0.35"/>
    <text x="290" y="736" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#1F36B1">Populer</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="780" width="342" height="56" rx="12" fill="#E3F2F6"/>
    <text x="195" y="815" text-anchor="middle" font-family="General Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#222741">Lanjutkan</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Bottom navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="748" width="390" height="96" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="0" y="748" width="390" height="1" fill="#DCDDDF"/>
    
    <!-- Home -->
    <g transform="translate(28,764)">
      <polygon points="12,0 0,10 24,10" fill="#3F63F6"/>
      <rect x="4" y="10" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="#3F63F6"/>
      <text x="12" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#3F63F6">Beranda</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Wallet -->
    <g transform="translate(109,764)">
      <rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="18" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <rect x="12" y="9" width="10" height="8" rx="3" fill="#75788D"/>
      <text x="12" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#75788D">Dompet</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Scan -->
    <g transform="translate(191,764)">
      <rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="22" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="2" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="12" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#75788D">Scan</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Activity -->
    <g transform="translate(271,764)">
      <rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="4,14 9,14 11,10 14,17 16,12 20,12" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="12" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#75788D">Aktivitas</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g transform="translate(346,764)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <rect x="5" y="14" width="14" height="8" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="12" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#75788D">Akun</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
